Charge | description = These charges are granted by and affect your Reap skill. }} '''Reap''' is a [[Physical damage|physical]] [[spell]] that [[hit]]s with physical damage and applies a strong physical [[damage over time]] [[debuff]] in a targeted [[Area of effect|area]]. If all enemies hit by this skill survive, the player gains a Blood Charge up to a maximum of 5. Blood charges increase this skill's [[damage]] and [[life]] cost. ==Skill functions and interactions== Casting Reap costs [[Life]] instead of [[Mana]]. The stat {{c|mod|Modifiers to Spell Damage apply to this Skill's Damage Over Time effect}} only applies to the physical damage over time debuff from this skill and not to any other damage over time effects applied using this skill. {{il|Spell Cascade Support}} or {{il|Greater Spell Cascade Support}} are particularly useful to scale the hit damage part of Reap. :The additional area of effects from Spell Cascade can overlaps slightly with the original AoE, which can result in additional hits on a single target. While Spell Cascade overlaps only once, Awakened Spell Cascade has three intrinsic overlaps, even when further reductions to AoE like {{il|Concentrated Effect Support}} are applied. The number of overlaps can be increased to four with at least 120% increased area of effect. ===Blood Charges=== Blood Charges have no intrinsic effects, has a default maximum of 5, and a default duration of 10 seconds. Gaining a Blood Charge refreshes the stack duration. Non-player objects such as [[totem]]s have a maximum of 0 Blood Charges, and [[proxy]] hits do not grant charges to the player.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/mqdzx8/path_of_exile_ultimatum_patch_notes/gufnt45/?context=1 Blood Charges are shared between multiple Reap skill gems, similar to how [[Inspiration Charge]]s are shared between multiple {{il|Inspiration Support}} gems. Generic charge duration such as those from [[Charge Mastery]] affect Blood Charge duration; skill duration does not affect it, however. {{il|Hydrosphere}} can be hit to generate Blood Charges, since it meets the criteria of surviving enemies. This can be used prior to engaging a boss to maximize damage output. The Hydrosphere will grant Blood Charges even while pulsing despite the hit cooldown. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Physical Damage |c1_header = Deals x to y Physical Damage |c1_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+) to (%d+) Physical Damage |c1_pattern_value = %d to %d |c2_abbr = Physical
DoT |c2_header = Deals x Base Physical Damage per second |c2_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+%.*%d*) Base Physical Damage per second |c2_pattern_value = %s }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Related helmet enchantments== The following helmet [[enchantments]] affects Reap: {{Query spawnable modifiers |q_where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%bloodreap%" OR mod_stats.id LIKE "%blood_scythe%" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |labyrinth=1 |level=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Reap %" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Reap %" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Reap: Now deals 2422.5 base Physical Damage per second at gem level 20 (previously 2002.5). }} {{Version history table row|3.27.0| * Now deals 15% more base Physical Damage per second with the Physical Damage over Time debuff. }} {{Version history table row|3.26.0| * Reap: Now deals 120.2-1741.3 Base Physical Damage per second at gem levels 1-20 (previously 120.2-1463.3). }} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now has 150% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 1, scaling up to 210% at gem level 20 (previously 210% at all gem levels). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes the skill to Deal +0-5% more Damage per Blood Charge, instead of providing 0-10% increased Area of Effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.0| * Reap now deals 57 to 86 Physical Damage at gem level 1 (previously 58 to 87), up to 943 to 1414 at gem level 20 (previously 702 to 1053). * Now deals 1463.3 Base Physical Damage per second at gem level 20 (previously 1463.1). * Now has 210% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 160%). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now grants Blood Charges when triggered. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.1| * Improved the targeting of the Reap skill. Previously, casting Reap while targeting a Monster could result in the skill failing to hit the Monster, as the skill was being cast from the point of your cursor. Now, casting Reap while targeting a Monster will cause the skill to be cast at the Monster's location. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=April 12, 2021|title=Reddit comment|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/mo2slb/reap_looks_like_a_fun_skill_but_dont_forget_how/gu7s8uj/|publisher=PoE Reddit|accessdate=Sept 28, 2023}} }} {{Navbox Skills}}
